public.title: Shortest Path to Get Food
public.description: Find the shortest number of horizontal or vertical steps from the single "*" start cell to any "#" food cell. "O" cells are walkable; "X" cells are blocked. Return -1 if no food is reachable. The grid is rectangular with 1 to 30 rows and columns, exactly one start, and zero or more food cells.
hints: Breadth-first search reaches cells in increasing distance.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Enqueue the start with distance zero. The first dequeued food cell is nearest. O(rows times columns) time and space.
